title: Fourier coefficients of the even part
statement: For every natural number $n$, every real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$, and every coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier coefficient of the even part of $f$ in its first coordinate at $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the corresponding set of tail coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$
